verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog data API that publishes its own MCP server for agents such as Cursor, Claude and ChatGPT to connect to. It is not an agent or host that consumes external MCP servers, so the MCP-client axis is a category error for this product. Its agentic search mode is an internal LLM query planner, not a way to plug in third-party MCP tools.
